calculators.title: Body Fat Calculator
calculators.desc: Estimate your body fat percentage with a tape measure (U.S. Navy method), then set a body-fat goal.

calculators.title: BMR Calculator
calculators.desc: Basal metabolic rate and daily calories for your age, weight and height, plus calories to lose or gain.

calculators.title: Baby Feeding Log
calculators.desc: One-tap breastfeeding timer, bottles, pumping and diapers, with today's totals.

calculators.title: Baby Growth Percentile Calculator
calculators.desc: Weight, length and head circumference percentiles on the WHO growth chart, with a private growth log.

calculators.title: Conception Date Calculator
calculators.desc: Work out when you conceived from your due date, last period or IVF transfer.

calculators.title: Contraction Timer
calculators.desc: One big button to time labour contractions: length, gaps, hourly average and a 5-1-1 rule alert.

calculators.title: Pregnancy Test Calculator
calculators.desc: The best day to take a pregnancy test: implantation days, earliest sensitive test and when a test is dependable.

calculators.title: Weeks Pregnant Calculator
calculators.desc: How many weeks pregnant you are today, your trimester and a week-by-week table with baby size.

calculators.title: Ovulation Calculator
calculators.desc: Find your fertile window, ovulation day and next period. Any cycle length, LH tests, private, adds to your calendar.

calculators.title: Period Calculator
calculators.desc: Predict your next period, log your cycles to get your own average, and see the year ahead.

calculators.title: Pregnancy Due Date Calculator
calculators.desc: Due date from your last period, conception, IVF transfer or a scan, with weeks pregnant and key dates.

calculators.title: Time Dilation Simulator
calculators.desc: How much would you age at close to the speed of light? Watch a traveller's clock, heartbeat and ageing slow down, see the light clock that explains why, fly the twin paradox at a steady 1 g, and calculate it.

tools.title: Ground Rod & Earthing Simulator
tools.desc: Find a ground rod's resistance for your soil, see why a rod doesn't trip a breaker, model lightning step voltage and static discharge, and read the grounding rules for your region.

tools.title: Julia Set Explorer
tools.desc: Drag a point on a map of the Mandelbrot set and watch its Julia set change live. Walk c around the cardioid, zoom and save pictures.

tools.title: Archive
tools.desc: Save or find any web page on the Wayback Machine, archive.today, Ghostarchive and more at once. Includes a one-click browser extension.

tools.title: Domain Lookup
tools.desc: Whois for the web: domain age, registrar, expiry, who hosts a site, DNS and email setup, and warning signs.

tools.title: EXIF Viewer
tools.desc: See the camera, date, GPS location and AI / edit flags hidden in a photo, and save a copy with the metadata removed.

tools.title: Reverse Image Search
tools.desc: Paste an image link or upload a picture and search Google Lens, Bing, TinEye, Yandex and more at once. Search part of the picture.

tools.title: Buddhabrot Explorer
tools.desc: Watch the Buddhabrot fill in live: millions of random Mandelbrot orbits piled into a glowing figure. Try the three-colour Nebulabrot and the Anti-Buddhabrot.

tools.title: Electromagnetic Fields Simulator
tools.desc: Place charges and wires and see field lines, Gauss's law and Ampère's law, steer a particle through E and B fields, and watch Maxwell's equations make waves reflect, refract and diffract.

tools.title: Double Pendulum
tools.desc: Drag two swinging arms into place and watch chaos: a fan of copies that drift apart, how fast errors grow, and a fractal map of how long each start takes to flip.

tools.title: Orbit Simulator
tools.desc: Launch planets by dragging, watch real gravity with many bodies, see Kepler's laws and equal areas, try Halley's comet, the Moon and a gravity assist, and compute orbit speeds and transfers.

tools.title: Metric Tensor Explorer
tools.desc: Type or pick a metric (Schwarzschild, de Sitter, a wormhole...) and get the Christoffel symbols, Riemann, Ricci and Einstein tensors, plus geodesics drawn on curved surfaces.

tools.title: Mandelbrot Explorer
tools.desc: Zoom into the Mandelbrot set, see the Julia set of any point, trace orbits and try the Burning Ship, Tricorn and Multibrot fractals.
